items.label: MA-AG civil: Ubuntu Autism Consultants, LLC
items.detail: Settlement of allegations that Ubuntu billed MassHealth managed care entities for ABA services not provided by properly credentialed or supervised staff; date is the announcement date. The $1.7 million is paid jointly by Ubuntu and its owner Ian Gatheca (Autism Behavioral Links is also named as part of the settlement); the separate ARTC settlement of $825,000 is a different case. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2023-ubuntu-autism; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: Ubuntu and its owner Ian Gatheca (an individual, also owner of Autism Behavioral Links, Inc.) pay one total, no split. Source (read 2026-10-11): "The settlement requires Ubuntu and Gatheca to pay $1.7 million". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2023-ubuntu-autism; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
